communication_goal: 请求具体反馈，并把建议转为可执行目标。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers having a supportive one-to-one conversation across a small round table. The developer on the left writes with a pen in ONE open paper notebook, clearly visible on the near edge of the table. The mentor on the right makes a gentle explanatory open-hand gesture. Keep the complete notebook, including its two pages and central binding, unobstructed and easy to crop. Comfortable seated poses, minimal office, no computers, no readable writing, no speech bubbles.

coverage_review.scope: W071 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

inversion.note: 原图保留；本卡发布用图为原图精确 RGB 反色（黑底白线）。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W071.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：两名同事在圆桌旁进行支持性谈话，左侧人用笔在打开的纸质笔记本记事，右侧人解释。笔记本两页与装订可见，手部局部遮挡不影响指代。导师关系和feedback/improve/goal由明确故事及对白支持。
